note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor2\TabularEditor.exe)) { Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/TabularEditor/TabularEditor/releases/download/2.29.0/TabularEditor.2.29.0.zip -OutFile C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor.2.29.0.zip; Expand-Archive C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor.2.29.0.zip C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor2 -Force; Get-ChildItem C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor2 -Recurse | Unblock-File }

screens.name: model-view
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep01\src\ContosoSales.pbip (Auto date/time off: File > Options and settings > Options > Global > Data load). If it will not open: blank report > TMDL view > paste TMDLScripts\create-model.tmdl > Apply, then turn on Discourage implicit measures in Model explorer
Home > Refresh; if asked for privacy levels or credentials choose Organizational / Windows
Go to Model view; arrange Sales in the centre, Date on top, Customer left, Product right, Store at the bottom
Show the four solid one-to-many lines with single arrowheads and the dashed line Sales[Ship Date] to Date[Date]
Hover the dashed line so both columns highlight; hold for a few seconds
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: te2-bpa
steps: Power BI Desktop: C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep01\src\ContosoSales.pbip open and refreshed (from the model-view screen)
Start C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor2\TabularEditor.exe (portable build: no External Tools button, that needs the MSI). Close any update/welcome prompt
File > Open > From DB... > Local instance: pick the ContosoSales Power BI Desktop entry > OK (the model tree shows Customer, Date, Product, Sales, Store)
Tools > Manage BPA Rules... > Add... > include a local rule file > type C:\MGLab\tools\bpa\BPARules.json > Open > OK (TE2 labels may differ slightly; the TE docs call it 'Include Rule File')

Press F10 (Best Practice Analyzer): the list of rules with violations; expand Provide format string for "Date" columns (Date[Date]), Remove unnecessary columns (Sales[Line Number]) and Visible objects with no description; hold on each
Write down every rule that appears and its object count (record the real list; demo.md has what the rule expressions predict)
Do not click Fix, Ignore or Save; File > Exit and answer No if asked to save
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Tabular Editor title bar shows localhost:<port>, which is fine; do not open File > Recent Files
Windows user name in the rule-file dialog (type the C:\MGLab path, do not browse the nav pane)

screens.name: data-pane
steps: Switch to Report view and expand the Data pane fully
Expand Sales: only Order Number and the display folders Sales and Margin (no keys, no Unit Price)
Expand Product to show the Product Hierarchy (Category > Subcategory > Product)
Expand Date to show the Calendar hierarchy; hold
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: report
steps: Report view, page Overview: matrix with Product[Category] rows, Date[Year] columns, values Sales Amount and Margin %
Check 2024 total 894,929.10, 2025 total 967,472.88, grand total 1,862,401.98, Bikes 2024 716,095.45, Margin % 43.7% both years
Add a Card with Orders (2,440); hold
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: unknown-customer
steps: Report view: table visual with Customer[Country] and Sales Amount, sort by Sales Amount descending
Show the row Unknown = 61,345.69 and that there is no (Blank) row; highlight the Unknown row with the cursor
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

teardown: # Tabular Editor 2 portable and the rule file stay in C:\MGLab\tools for later episodes; to remove: Remove-Item C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor2, C:\MGLab\tools\TabularEditor.2.29.0.zip, C:\MGLab\tools\bpa -Recurse -Force
owner_notes: Local only: no tenant, no sign-in. Close Power BI Desktop without saving into the repo. te2-bpa uses Tabular Editor 2 portable (free, MIT), downloaded by prepare into C:\MGLab\tools: no admin, no sign-in.
